description: Make agent sessions visible in WebUI - real-time streaming and historical replay

tasks.title: Create agent_session_message DB table and repo
tasks.description: Create the agent_session_message table in SQLite with columns: id, issue_id, session_id, role, content, tool_calls, tool_call_id, tool_name, tool_result, step_index, message_index, created_at. Create an AgentSessionMessageRepo class with insert and findByIssueId methods. Register the table in the DB initialization flow.
acceptanceCriteria: agent_session_message table is created on server startup with correct schema
AgentSessionMessageRepo.findByIssueId returns messages ordered by step_index and message_index
Index on (issue_id, step_index, message_index) exists
npm run build succeeds
tasks.notes: Follow existing repo patterns in packages/cli/src/db/

tasks.title: Create coder_session DB table and repo
tasks.description: Create the coder_session table in SQLite with columns: id, issue_id, acp_session_id, execution_id, task_description, status, created_at, completed_at. Create a CoderSessionRepo class with insert, updateStatus, and findByIssueId methods. Register the table in the DB initialization flow.
acceptanceCriteria: coder_session table is created on server startup with correct schema
CoderSessionRepo.findByIssueId returns sessions ordered by created_at
Index on issue_id exists
npm run build succeeds

tasks.title: Persist Main Agent messages after runAgentLoop completes
tasks.description: Modify agent-loop.ts to write messages to agent_session_message table after the fullStream completes. Extract role, content, tool_calls, tool_result from each ModelMessage. Pass a repo instance through the runAgentLoop options. Wire the repo in main-agent.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: After runAgentLoop completes, all step messages are in agent_session_message table
Assistant messages with tool_calls have the tool_calls field populated as JSON
Tool result messages have tool_call_id, tool_name, and tool_result populated
step_index aligns with result.steps array index and message_index aligns with message position within step
npm run build succeeds
tasks.notes: Also fix the parallel tool call executionId bug by replacing single currentExecutionId with a toolCallId -> executionId Map

tasks.title: Record coder session mapping on ACP spawn and completion
tasks.description: Modify spawn-coder.ts / acp-session.ts to create a coder_session row immediately after the ACP sessionId is obtained, and update status to completed/failed when the session finishes. Pass CoderSessionRepo through the options chain from agent-runner-service.
acceptanceCriteria: When runAcpSession obtains a sessionId, a coder_session row with status='running' is created
When runAcpSession succeeds, coder_session status is updated to 'completed'
When runAcpSession fails or times out after session creation, coder_session status is updated to 'failed'
npm run build succeeds

tasks.title: Add REST API endpoints for session data
tasks.description: Add two new API endpoints: GET /issues/:number/agent-session returns agent_session_message rows for the issue. GET /issues/:number/coder-sessions returns coder_session rows with their associated workflow_log entries (filtered by acp_session_id). Wire into the HTTP server router.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /issues/:number/agent-session returns array of messages with correct fields
GET /issues/:number/coder-sessions returns array with workflow_log entries nested
Both endpoints return empty arrays when no data exists
npm run build succeeds
tasks.notes: Add routes in packages/cli/src/api/ following existing patterns

tasks.title: Update frontend types and SSE subscription for agent detail events
tasks.description: Add TypeScript types for agent_text_chunk, main_tool_call, coder_text_chunk, coder_tool_call, ralph_task_update, ralph_loop_progress to lib/types.ts EventMap. Update useSSE.ts to subscribe to these events and dispatch them via a lightweight global event emitter (e.g. EventTarget) so components can subscribe without creating duplicate SSE connections.
acceptanceCriteria: EventMap in types.ts includes all 6 new event types with correct payload shapes
useSSE subscribes to all new event types
Agent text chunks are accumulated into a buffer accessible to components
Tool call events are collected into a timeline array
npm run build succeeds in packages/cli/web

tasks.title: Create useAgentSession hook for historical + live data
tasks.description: Create a new React hook useAgentSession(issueNumber) that: (1) fetches historical data from GET /agent-session and GET /coder-sessions on mount, (2) subscribes to global SSE event emitter for live updates, (3) merges historical and live events using (stepIndex, executionId) deduplication, (4) returns a unified activity list with text buffers and tool call timeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Hook returns { messages, toolCalls, coderSessions, isStreaming }
Historical data is loaded on mount via React Query
Live SSE events are appended to the historical data via global event emitter
Tool call events are deduplicated by executionId to avoid duplicate timeline entries
npm run build succeeds in packages/cli/web
tasks.notes: Use useRef for text buffer, requestAnimationFrame for batched renders

tasks.title: Build AgentSessionPanel component
tasks.description: Create the AgentSessionPanel React component that renders: streaming agent text with typing cursor, tool call timeline with collapsible entries (name, status, duration, expandable args/result), coder session sub-timelines with their own tool calls, and ralph task progress indicators. Replace the static blue box in IssueDetailPage.
acceptanceCriteria: Component renders streaming text with smooth updates (no per-chunk re-render)
Tool calls shown as timeline entries with status icons and duration
Completed tool calls are collapsible with args/result on expansion
Coder sessions display as nested sub-timelines
Component works in both live and historical modes
Replaces the 'Agent is running...' blue box in IssueDetailPage
npm run build succeeds in packages/cli/web
tasks.notes: Use Tailwind CSS consistent with existing components
